title: The Spire of Ashvale
author: G. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Rafael Coldharbour, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
